name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct as EXCAVA’s primary inference engine. Its MoE design delivers 235B active parameters with 22B experts, hitting the sweet spot between raw power and efficiency—beating older dense models like DeepSeek-R1-671B on most benchmarks while using far fewer compute cycles. The trade-off is vendor lock-in to Qwen’s ecosystem, but the model’s open-weight release and strong community support mitigate that risk.

name: Torque
text: Qwen3-235B-A22B’s MoE routing overhead will spike EXCAVA’s latency at scale—its 22B experts demand real-time gating that burns 15-20% of inference cycles. DeepSeek-R1-671B’s dense 671B parameters won’t fit in EXCAVA’s 8xA100 shard, but its 671B dense model already runs slower than a pruned 405B on the same hardware. Run a head-to-head: measure tokens/sec and p99 latency on a 10K-token prompt—if Qwen3’s MoE beats the pruned 405B by >0.5% on both, adopt it; else, drop it.
